questions.question:
[경로: Flavonoid 생합성]
다음 경로에서 ★로 표시한 물질의 이름은?

[[rxn:O=C(SC)/C=C/c1ccc(O)cc1>>O=C(/C=C/c1ccc(O)cc1)c1c(O)cc(O)cc1O|malonyl-CoA × 3, chalcone synthase(Claisen)]]
(★ → chalcone)

[[rxn:O=C(/C=C/c1ccc(O)cc1)c1c(O)cc(O)cc1O>>O=C1CC(c2ccc(O)cc2)Oc2cc(O)cc(O)c21|고리화(isomerase)]]
(chalcone → flavanone)
questions.explanation:
정답: 4-hydroxycinnamoyl-CoA
전체 경로:
4-hydroxycinnamoyl-CoA →(malonyl-CoA × 3, chalcone synthase(Claisen))→ chalcone
chalcone →(고리화(isomerase))→ flavanone
flavanone →(3-수산화)→ dihydroflavonol
dihydroflavonol →(산화)→ flavonol
참고: flavanone → flavone(apigenin), isoflavone(genistein). dihydroflavonol → anthocyanidin, catechin.
그림:
[[img:pharmacognosy/images/2023-mid-q27.png|족보 그림]]
